Transition Metal Compounds With Formal Charges Instantly Fail (ORCA)
Hello! I am doing some computations related to several first row closed-shelled transition metal molecules and running into issues with ORCA. Any time I try to run a molecule with a formal charge, the computation instantly fails. Does anyone have any insight for this issue? I'm happy to provide any information that you may need to resolve this issue, but I am still very new to ORCA and computational chemistry in general.
